candidate_relations.reason: Mycosis fungoides is a specific subtype of CTCL, and the ichthyosiform variant is the required specificity given the 12-year history of ichthyosis-like scaly patches plus nodules, clonal TCR rearrangement, and CD4+ epidermotropic infiltrate. 'Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD4-positive' is the parent class and does not capture the MF subtype or ichthyosiform qualifier.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the broad parent category (cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD4+) but omits the specific subtype (mycosis fungoides) and the defining clinical variant (ichthyosiform presentation)

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a rare variant of MF; candidate correctly identifies CTCL lineage and CD4 positivity but lacks subtype and variant specificity
